about: Genera that the P10K database paper (Gao et al., Nucleic Acids Res 52:D747, 2024, doi:10.1093/nar/gkad992, Figure 3) labels with NCBI codon table 12 (CUG = Ser). PREREGISTRATION.md addendum A5.4: recorded before any eukcode output for these genera is seen, and not edited afterwards.
how_read: Figure 3 ('Genetic codes of ciliates', open access) was saved at full size (2787 x 1335 px) by a read-only browser session on 2026-11-18 and read label by label on 2026-11-19. At that time no eukcode job had produced any output (no pilot, census, screen or check 2 result existed). The P10K portal has no codon-table column; its gene pages were checked for two Euplotes datasets on 2026-11-18.

figure3_labels.Euplotes: 10,12 with red arrow and '(10)' (P10K disagrees with NCBI)

insdc_sets_for_the_table12_dataset.note: INSDC transcriptome sets of the same organism and strain found via the ENA portal on 2026-11-19 (tax_tree(5935), genus Euplotes).
insdc_sets_for_the_table12_dataset.HBJK01000000: Euplotes focardii strain TN1, 2021 EBI/ELIXIR re-assembly of the MMETSP reads (project PRJEB37159; runs SRR1296783, SRR1296928; BioSample SAMN02740072), 30.1 Mb. Probably the same MMETSP sample as P10K's table-12 dataset (MMETSP0205), in a different assembly; the run-to-MMETSP-ID link was not checked.
insdc_sets_for_the_table12_dataset.GKLJ01000000: Euplotes focardii strain TN1, independent 2023 sequencing (project PRJNA896607), 21.3 Mb.
